 On Saturday, the San Francisco 49ers announced the following roster moves ahead of Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders:
 Activated WR Demarcus Robinson from the injured reserve list
 Elevated WR KhaDarel Hodge from the team's practice squad (standard elevation)
 Placed WR Christian Kirk on injured reserve
 Robinson has been out since going down with an ankle injury in week two. In those first two games, the 11-year vet caught five passes for 84 yards and one touchdown. With Mike Evans , Deebo Samuel , and Christian Kirk out, the 49ers will need Robinson's veteran presence to go along with veteran Brandin Cooks and youngsters Jordan Watkins and Jacob Cowing . Robinson's "questionable" game status was removed. He is expected to play against the Raiders.
 Hodge will primarily be used on special teams, which is where he is best. The nine-year player made the Pro Bowl in 2024 as a special teamer. In 2026, Hodge has appeared in three games. Though he has received most of his snaps on special teams, he has played some on offense. He's been targeted in the passing game once and has one catch for 18 yards.
 Kirk will now go on IR with an MCL injury. The nine-year wideout has spent time in Houston, Jacksonville, and Arizona. He's only appeared in one game for the 49ers this season, due to a lengthy calf injury suffered on the first day of training camp. In his one game this season, Kirk came away with no catches or targets. His latest injury was sustained during the team's bye week.
 Kirk signed a one-year contract with the 49ers on March 18th. It's possible this stint on injured reserve is season-ending, which could end his short-lived career with San Francisco.
 The 49ers look to improve to 7-1 on Sunday at Levi's Stadium. Kickoff is scheduled for 1:25 pm (PST).
